args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 to address CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; high severity).

- Affected: <2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0
- Fixed in: 2.9.4, 3.1.0

Per the team's completed fastjson 3.x migration, this takes the 3.x fix (3.1.0).

CI: passed (ci-0001)
